timing: wall_s includes fresh app-server startup, thread configuration, first model call and focus bookends; excludes fixture setup and independent verifier. prompt_wall_s separately times turn/start to turn/completed.
vault_timing: wall_s additionally includes client-only app binding, redaction-helper initialization and documentation audit; prompt_wall_s excludes that setup.
model_identity_source: live model/list and thread/start echo; turn/start explicitly sets model/service/effort; provider model fallback disabled; reroutes invalidate row; upstream per-response identity not exposed
ordering: repetition, task; Sol/Astra in r1, Astra/Sol in r2; vault slots completed afterward in the same counterbalanced arm order
vault_deviation: Vault uses client-only native binding and native AX line redaction before model exposure. No task-specific inputs or UI actions are scripted; original canary/focus/task verifiers unchanged.
focus_note: Violations count foreground samples from the original monitor, not distinct focus-steal events; zero probe errors in all 24 rows.
token_note: Reported cumulative thread totals. Cached input is a subset of input. Astra failed dense r2 has null usage; aggregate sums cover 11/12 Astra rows, not a complete total.
failure_note: Astra dense r2 ended failed before any native tool. The original observer retained status but not error detail; root cause unavailable. This attempt is retained without replacement.
native_tool_methods_note: Syntactic method names from completed RPC arguments only; helper-internal methods, action execution and provider-transmitted screenshots are not counted by this field. native_tool_calls counts model-requested native RPCs only; client-only vault setup calls are excluded.
